fusions.name: Folded Dart
fusions.desc: Throws a folded dart that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises +5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +25%).

fusions.name: Signed Decree
fusions.desc: Brings a decree down on the target, dealing 32 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Posted Notice
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Margin Note
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
